relevance.rationale: A review chapter on Ranada field-line solutions of vacuum Maxwell and their extension to Born-Infeld nonlinear electrodynamics (null hopfion solutions survive). It contains no original result. The corpus has no Ranada/knotted-EM-field thread at all (zero hits for 'Ranada' across content/), and the single paragraph it could touch -- the 'photonic hopfions' alignment in rem:breit-wheeler-vertex-literature -- is better served by the primary construction in library/arxiv-1302.0342v1/1302.0342v1.pdf in this same slice, which gives the torus-knot family the corpus's inventory actually uses. Judged tangential rather than supporting deliberately: adding a second, secondary citation to a single interpretive paragraph would be citation padding.
